div.head: Northu 38
div.ab: Gif preost misendebirde ciriclice gearþenunga, dæges oððe nihtes, gebete þæt.
Gif preost misendebirde ciriclice gearþenunga, dæges oððe nihtes, gebete þæt.
Wenn ein Priester kirchliche Jahr[estag-Gottes]dienste bei Tage oder Nacht falsch abhält, büsse er das.
If a priest wrongly orders the church's annual services [for feast-days], by day or by night, let him atone for it.
If a priest performs in a wrong order the annual services of the church, by day or night, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest performs the annual services of the church in the wrong sequence, by day or night, he is to atone for that.
div.note: Liebermann compares Canons of Edgar 50.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If a priest performs in the wrong order the annual services of the church, by day or night, he is to compensate for it.’).

Liturgy of a particular feast; Toller 1046 IVa; cf. geargerihta 43 [on the other hand ‘annual services’ Thorpe, Toller 368b; ‘Jahresdienst’ Schmid]; yerdai, yearday: ‘anniversarius’ from Middle English onwards
